carpet.rule.endGatewayCooldown.name: End Gateway Cooldown
carpet.rule.endGatewayCooldown.desc: Disables the 2-second cooldown between end gateway teleports. Enable to allow unlimited teleportation without cooldown.
carpet.rule.itemEntityAlarm.name: Item Entity Alarm
carpet.rule.itemEntityAlarm.desc: When enabled, alerts all players in chat when a single chunk has 2000 or more item entities, including coordinates and count.
carpet.rule.railForceStatePlacement.name: Rail Force State Placement
carpet.rule.railForceStatePlacement.desc: When enabled, Easy Place forces the rail shape from schematic projection, ignoring support conditions. Easy-placed rails permanently retain their shape and are unaffected by any subsequent block placements (rail or non-rail). When a rail is broken, the mark is cleared and manual placement resumes normal behavior.
carpet.rule.disableRailShapeUpdate.name: Disable Rail Shape Update
carpet.rule.disableRailShapeUpdate.desc: When enabled, all rails (normal, powered, detector) will not change their shape/direction due to neighbor block changes. Power, redstone signal, and other normal functions remain unaffected.
When enabled with flippinCactus, right-clicking rails with cactus cycles through all valid shapes without triggering block or neighbor updates.
